verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler has a dedicated trademarks practice page within its Intellectual Property group, titled for trademark services and registration. It states the firm manages national and global trademark portfolios for hundreds of clients, which supports the 'own practice' and registration elements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of trademark clearance/search work, explicit brand enforcement (oppositions, cease-and-desist, litigation), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Trademark Services | Trademark Registration | Trademark Law Firm
The firm manages the national and global trademark portfolios of hundreds of clients that span a diverse array of industries
